svg.aria-label: Three penguin species trace three Fourier signatures
svg.title: Three penguin species trace three Fourier signatures
svg.desc: Andrews curves: every penguin's standardised bill length, bill depth, flipper length and body mass are encoded as a Fourier curve over t from minus pi to pi, coloured by species. Adélie in blue, Chinstrap in orange and Gentoo in green each form a distinct band, with the bold median curve of each species drawn on top.
svg.text: Three penguin species trace three Fourier signatures
Each curve turns one bird's four body measurements into an Andrews series; bold lines are the species medians. Illustrative data.

g.title: Adélie — 26 birds; bold line is the species median curve

Gentoo — 26 birds; bold line is the species median curve
